biothings.name: thrombocytopenia-absent radius syndrome
biothings.definition: Thrombocytopenia-absent radius (TAR) syndrome is a very rare congenital malformation syndrome characterized by bilateral radial aplasia and thrombocytopenia. [Orphanet:3320]
biothings.synonyms: 1q21.1 susceptibility locus for Thrombocytopenia-Absent Radius (TAR) syndrome, radial aplasia-thrombocytopenia syndrome, TAR syndrome, Thrombocytopenia Absent Radius Syndrome, thrombocytopenia-absent radius syndrome
